performance.verdict: Spend throttle is intentional, but 6 overdue milestones now block the path back up.

findings.text: CPL sits at $238 on just 7 leads over 28 days; 3-day lead count (Sep 12–14) is 1 vs 1 in prior 3 (Sep 9–11) — volume too thin to read efficiency reliably.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 — overdue 2026-08-31. Speed-to-lead automations point at a vacant seat, blocking all budget scale-up.
5 additional overdue milestones (booking bot battle-test due 7/31, Review Boost, Financing page, Homer Glen branch all due 8/31, LSA heating toggle due 9/1) — none marked complete.
Google Ads spend collapsed 67% in last 7 days to ~$11/day; 3-day Google spend (Sep 12–14: $11.75, $10.47, $27.93) confirms sustained pullback, cutting clicks from an already thin 137 over 28 days.

GBP 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' generated only 1 call from 217 impressions (0.46% call rate) over 28 days; 'Fibid Heating & Air Conditioning' 1 call from 126 impressions (0.79%) — both profiles converting impressions to calls far below the third profile's 2.44%.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner and GHL login immediately — unblocks all budget scale-up gated on this since 2026-08-31.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and the intake owner has not been confirmed, leaving speed-to-lead automations pointing at a vacant seat. This milestone was due 2026-08-31 and directly gates the SOW scale-back-up decision. Success check: named owner, verified GHL login, and after-hours coverage confirmed by 2026-09-19. No budget increases should be approved until this is closed.

suggestions.text: Audit and update GBP profiles for 'Quality HVAC by Fibid' (0.46% call rate, 1 call / 217 impressions) to improve call conversion.
suggestions.monday_update: Two GBP profiles are converting impressions to calls at 0.46% and 0.79% respectively, vs 2.44% on the third profile — a 3–5x gap on the same impression base. Review and update both underperforming listings: ensure call button is prominent, hours are accurate, and primary category matches search intent. Success check: call rate on both profiles rises above 1.5% within the next 28-day window. Re-check 2026-10-13.
